plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/SKILL..why: Carries four rules from Michael Denyer's pstack-claude in T3 wording: load a managed platform's skill before deploying, stop an abandoned agent whose writes could overlap its replacement's with task_cancel and confirm with task_status that it stopped, which Autopilot-full's immediate replacement of a stuck agent overrides, keep a review gate closed while no independent reviewer can run, and keep the todolist in .audit/<task-slug>.todo.md when the session has no task tool.

plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.why: Points step 4 at the Subagents rule that every file-writing delegate gets its own worktree from HEAD, and carries the rule from Michael Denyer's pstack-claude that the delegator commits what the delegate builds on, names that commit in the brief, and never writes or runs a suite in a worktree a delegate still holds.

Carries the rule from Michael Denyer's pstack-claude that every live agent holding a worktree is stopped, and the stop confirmed, before a commit, merge, or deploy from it, and drops the reset --hard between delegates on one branch so that each gets its own worktree.

Adds --match-head-commit <head> to the GitHub merge in step 4, the head guard from Michael Denyer's pstack-claude, with the current head whose verdict survives step 3's patch-id rule, so a head pushed after that check cannot land, and stops step 5's watcher loop at a merge gate that needs a person.

Prunes with a plain git worktree remove whose refusal is the stop, never a force flag or a hand delete, as sergchil/jutsu da94424 does, pauses on untracked scratch and deletes only the paths the user approves with a literal-pathspec git clean, names the ignored, reflog, and unknown labels the audit adds with the status call it counts from, reads a prunable worktree's HEAD and reflog from the main checkout instead of a bulk prune, and documents the audit's --fetch.

plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/script.why: Expects the --settle default that cli.ts adds.
Adds the --settle option (default 300 seconds, 0 disables) that the T3 settle overlay in settle.ts reads.
Gives the fake reader the reviewActivity method the settle overlay adds to GitHubReader.

Gives the gh reader the reviewActivity method that settle.ts uses, and carries two fixes from Michael Denyer's pstack-claude: a completed check that gh buckets as pending, such as STALE, reads as failed instead of pending forever (pstack-claude #97), and a head with no checks configured reads as such when gh reports none and the head has no rollup (pstack-claude #153).
Sets settle: 0 on the shared PollingOptions, so the upstream tests run with the settle overlay off.

Holds READY while settle.ts reports the PR settling, and carries two fixes from Michael Denyer's pstack-claude: a required review or another branch protection rule that blocks the frontier PR with clean CI stops at a merge gate instead of reading as READY (pstack-claude #95), and a PR with no checks configured gets a verdict instead of retrying forever, once GitHub has computed mergeability and no commit on it has reported checks (pstack-claude #153). A BLOCKED read at the frontier or on a no-checks head stops the watcher only once the same head has read BLOCKED, with no check pending, for 60 seconds, and it waits meanwhile as a confirming-block WAITING that spends no query-error budget (the guard from pstack-claude #223, widened).

Prints the settle column and the review-settling lines from settle.ts, and the review-required, branch-protection, and no-checks states that the fixes from Michael Denyer's pstack-claude add, with a merge-gate action that says a person is needed and the confirming-block wait and timeout lines.

Adds the settle state, decision, and reader method that settle.ts defines, and the review-required and merge-blocked gates, the no-checks read and CI state, and the confirming-block wait and timeout reason that the fixes from Michael Denyer's pstack-claude add.

Holds a worktree with untracked scratch, with an ignored file whose last component is not a named build or cache directory, with a commit only HEAD or its reflog reaches, or that git cannot read, the ignored and reflog checks ported from Michael Denyer's pstack-claude #277, passes --untracked-files so a status.showUntrackedFiles=no config hides nothing, fetches the base only under --fetch, and sets GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 so its git status never rewrites a worktree's index.

plugins/pstack/skills/setup-pstack/SKILL.why: Writes the T3 model sheet from orchestrator_capabilities targets and checks it with t3-sheet.mjs, in place of Cursor's always-applied .mdc rule built from model slugs. Steps 7 and 8 open the generator's SKILL.md by its path from this file instead of invoking it, since on Claude Code the Skill tool refuses a skill with disable-model-invocation, a conflict Eric Litman's open-pstack recorded in its 0.15.29 sync (#234).
